description: Conversation tracking (T3c O2; 0.8.0 T3g held-open collapse): a seeded turn cursor over the retained conversation fork derives addressees (name mention of a known actor_ref, second person to the last addresser), a bounded CANDIDATE parent set per undeclared turn (QUD top / latest pending address / latest contrasted claim / adjacent other-speaker turn / addressee's last turn) with cue edges to the closed EqTrkCue codebook, collapse only on strict cue-set dominance (strong >= 2 cues, weak 1; else HELD, never tiebroken), uptake revision over a per-actor held frontier, eq_answers, the open-question set (eq_qud) and same-actor continuation. EqSecondPerson / EqBackchannel / EqPolarAux / EqPolarAnswer closed-class codebooks.
